They’re gonna attempt to sprint through our defenses!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 28 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Rusher''' is a fast enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It had appeared in [[The Takeover Event]] as well. It has high health, along with extremely fast speed. However, when it loses all of its [[Shield Health]], its shield is destroyed, reducing its speed. == Logbook Description == ''"Fallen Rushers were the kingdom's frontline shield, trained to charge head-first into battle. Their role was to push through the enemy defenses. They wore light armor for speed and most knew they would not survive, but they did it willingly to protect those who followed after them. Their shield can be destroyed, leaving them defenseless."'' ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Rusher''' has black skin. Its body has blue cracks on it. It wears metal gloves and shoes with spikes on them and a metal helmet. It has grey bandages on its arms and legs. It carries a grey shield with blue accents. The shield has a large blue gem in the center. When it loses all its shield health, it loses the shield that it carries. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Accelerator]] can be quite effective against this. **The [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to boost these towers. *Splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] can be useful against this enemy, as they can quickly get rid of shield health from multiple '''Fallen Rushers'''. *Because of its fast speed, stalling towers like the [[Cryomancer]], [[trapper]](bear traps only)or [[Freezer]] can be quite useful. **Some of these towers can also be used to drop the '''Fallen Rusher's''' defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenRusherSprint.gif|Sprinting animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenRusherShieldlessSprint.gif|Shieldless Sprinting animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenRusherWithoutShield.png|Green variant, current version, withotu shield variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseModernFallenRusher.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, with shield variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseModernFallenRusher2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, without shield variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} FallenTeaser2.jpg|'''Fallen Rusher''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Rusher''' on a promotional video.
